From 1e3f387736c744e73b5398a147b90412f82f54da Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: MeiChia Chiu <meichia.chiu@mediatek.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Oct 2023 23:38:54 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mt76: mt7996: fix rate usage of inband discovery frames

For UBPR and FILS frames, the BSS_CHANGED_BEACON flag will also be set,
which causes those frames to use the beacon rate in TX descriptors.
Adjust the statement to fix this issue.

Fixes: 98686cd21624 ("wifi: mt76: mt7996: add driver for MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) devices")
Signed-off-by: MeiChia Chiu <meichia.chiu@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Shayne Chen <shayne.chen@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Felix Fietkau <nbd@nbd.name>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
index b17365b8d07b..6f1ade64bcb2 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
@@ -860,10 +860,10 @@ void mt7996_mac_write_txwi(struct mt7996_dev *dev, __le32 *txwi,
 	struct mt76_vif *mvif;
 	u16 tx_count = 15;
 	u32 val;
-	bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
-				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED));
 	bool inband_disc = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_UNSOL_BCAST_PROBE_RESP |
 					 BSS_CHANGED_FILS_DISCOVERY));
+	bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
+				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED)) && (!inband_disc);
 
 	mvif = vif ? (struct mt76_vif *)vif->drv_priv : NULL;
 	if (mvif) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c`**
   - The original boolean variable `beacon` was defined to check if the `changed` variable included the flags `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON` or `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED`.
   - The modification updates the definition of `beacon` to also ensure that the `inband_disc` condition (which checks for `BSS_CHANGED_UNSOL_BCAST_PROBE_RESP` or `BSS_CHANGED_FILS_DISCOVERY`) is not true. This change prevents the beacon rate from being used for inband discovery frames.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `mac.c` directly addresses a bug related to the handling of inband discovery frames in the context of beacon rate usage. By adjusting the logic that determines when the `beacon` variable is true, the patch ensures that inband discovery frames do not incorrectly utilize the beacon rate in transmission descriptors. This change is a corrective measure for the previously introduced functionality in commit `98686cd21624`, which added support for MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 devices. The fix enhances the proper functioning of the driver by refining the conditions under which beacon rates are applied.

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED));
bool inband_disc = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_UNSOL_BCAST_PROBE_RESP |
 					 BSS_CHANGED_FILS_DISCOVERY));
```
Reason:
The original logic incorrectly sets the `beacon` variable to true when the `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON` flag is present, without considering whether the frame is an inband discovery frame (UBPR or FILS). This leads to the transmission descriptors using the beacon rate for these frames, which is inappropriate.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED)) && (!inband_disc);
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the `beacon` variable to only be true if the `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON` flag is set and the frame is not an inband discovery frame. This adjustment ensures that inband discovery frames do not use the beacon rate, thus correcting the improper rate usage.
